The industrial planning model successfully achieved a 1.0 reward by correctly implementing backlog transitions and initial conditions.
The model accurately derived the Week 5 initial backlog by setting the prior week's end-of-week state to satisfy the 'Start of Week Past Due + Scheduled Demand = 1014.51' constraint. It successfully managed state transitions from 6-day to 4-day work weeks based on signed backlog and buffer calculations. Post-execution validation confirmed the Excel output contained exactly 49 data weeks and met all summary length constraints.
